d:
Lagatar uttejnaon aur dijital bhatkav ke bich ham fokas kaise banae rakhen? kya tailent, trening ya teknoloji madad kar sakti hai? nyurosaintist aur mental koch batate hain ki dimag men ekagrata, yani konsantreshan ki kya bhumika hai.
Barhte dabav vali duniya men hamara konsantreshan lagatar kam hota nazar aata hai. har taraf bhatkav vali chizen hone ke bavjud dimag fokas kaise karta hai? ise behtar tariqe se samajhne ke lie yah dokyumentri ek top ethlit, ek eyar traifik kantrolar treni aur ek ee-sports profeshnal ko folo karti hai.
